Mapper plan (docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md, §3 Phase 2 'Support honesty'): this lands in Phase 2 after the D1B-signatures ticket and before recall-map, reliability and H4. Acceptance criteria added 2026-09-18:
1. hsmm/v4 publishes tagged support Assessed / Unestablished / NotApplicable with an explicit support basis, and carries the exact source intervals that D1B-signatures adds to HsmmResult.
2. Empty or zero-weight eligible evidence never publishes full support; a mutation restoring the false full-support value fails a named test.
3. hsmm/v3 artifacts are refused by the v4 decoder with a typed error; migration documentation states that artifacts are re-derived, not upgraded (codec/README.md:29), and no converter is built.
4. codec/README.md's schema field list and ADR 0001's portability contract are updated for v4 in the same change (absorbing bd-01M1D214VVRE118RTEQQ09P7SA, closed as merged).
5. Platform-labelled goldens (JVM/JS/Native) are added, coordinating with the Native 1-ULP bead bd-01M1D215EY4T5BR0VRJ694AMBQ.
6. Construction checks on the new types; Sherlock per-unit anchor parity (pinned by D1B-signatures) holds before this wire change, and any numerical movement after it is reported, not silently rebaselined.
7. The rebase-or-redo decision on branch scout/support-assessment-v4 (about 450 commits behind main) is recorded.
